Module.Name: gaia-iml
Module.Description: Gaia DR3 variable star detection using IntegratedML Custom Models + AI Hub. Scans 21 gzipped epoch photometry files, ingests flux stats into IRIS, scores each source with SQL PREDICT() using a pre-trained custom GradientBoostingClassifier IRISModel. ~5s end-to-end. InterSystems Employee Programming Challenge #1.
